subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help-only for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, but a configurable TUI preference would add public config/API surface under a repository policy with a high bar for new config options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow TUI config or CLI surface with default and customized send/newline tests.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Backlog
options.body: Track configurable send keys with broader composer/keybinding work such as external editor, long-prompt modal, and vi-mode requests.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied prior review context and have the clearest recent history across the adjacent WebChat shortcut decision and TUI docs surface.
